user_story: As a devotee I want to subscribe to a Panchangam calendar feed for my city so Tithi/Nakshatra appear in my calendar
As a devotee I want to see Ekadashi clearly marked in my calendar so I know to prepare for my fast
As a devotee I want Amavasya / Pournami / Pradosham / Shani Pradosham highlighted in my calendar
As a devotee I want to see Rahu Kalam / Gulika / Yamagandam / Varjyam / Durmuhurtham timings in the day description so I can plan around them
As a devotee I want to see Brahma Muhurta / Abhijit Muhurta / Amrita Kalam timings in the day description so I can use them for auspicious activities
As a devotee I want to see Choghadiya blocks and full Panchangam metadata in the day description
As a devotee I want to get the full day metadata (Samvatsara / Maasam / Paksham / Vaaram / solar and lunar signs) in the calendar event description
As a devotee I want to pick my city and calculation system on a landing page and get my webcal subscription URL
As a scholar or priest I want to choose Surya Siddhanta or Vakya system for ritual-accurate timings
As a maintainer I want feeds regenerated automatically each month without any manual intervention
